lesson.title: Review Day: The Age of Exploration
lesson.subject: social-studies

contentBlocks.text: This week you learned about the Age of Exploration. Let's review it all!

Quick review: kingdoms wanted faster trade routes and wealth (Day 1). The compass, astrolabe, and better ships made long voyages possible (Day 2). Columbus's 1492 voyage reached the Caribbean (Day 3). Exploration connected the world through an exchange of goods (Day 4). Answer: why did explorers set sail, what tool helped them, and what year did Columbus's voyage happen?
Wonderful work this week — you learned real history about why and how the Age of Exploration happened! Next week we'll explore something new.

objectives: Review exploration's motivations, tools, key voyages, and global connections
Recall a motivation, a tool, and the year of Columbus's voyage
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Do the quick walk-through review of all 4 days together, out loud.
2. Have the child answer all three review questions.
3. Complete the review worksheet.
4. Celebrate finishing a full week of Age of Exploration history!
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus on just the 1492/Columbus fact, the most concrete and memorable of the week's content
Ready for more: ask the child to connect this week back to last week's Indigenous-peoples content in one sentence
This is a good checkpoint to note which of the week's four topics needs the most reinforcement before the next Social Studies unit, which will explore colonization's consequences more deeply
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a recall and review activity — check that the child can name a real motivation (trade/wealth), a real tool (compass/astrolabe/ship design), and correctly state 1492 as the year of Columbus's voyage.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Consolidates this week's C3 Framework History content before the course continues, matching the established Day-5-review pacing used across every unit this session.

generationData.instructions: Answer each question to review this week.

rows.problem: Why did explorers want a faster ocean route to Asia?
Name one tool that helped make long ocean voyages possible.
What year did Columbus's voyage take place?
